input.title: Unclear scope of "Baustelleneinrichtung herstellen"
input.message: The short text does not specify which facilities, equipment, or quantities are to be provided, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which requires a clear and exhaustive description.
input.suggestion: Add a detailed list of all required items (e.g., site offices, fencing, storage containers, temporary utilities) with quantities and dimensions.
